envelope.description: Add the route and require exactly its document set in prepareReviewPacket

body.title: Add the route and require exactly its document set in prepareReviewPacket
body.summary: Add the StoryRoute description (epicHash, storyId, whether a PLAN, LLD, ISSUE and DEF exist, the BUILD's task ids and focus) and make prepareReviewPacket take an optional route: with a route require exactly the set it implies (a Plan: lld and plan, plus story only when a DEF exists; only an LLD: lld; only an ISSUE: issue; otherwise none) and check each document's workflow, epicHash or issueHash and story. With a Plan keep all Plan validation, units and messages. A route without a Plan returns the validated documents and no units until the derived unit is added. Without a route, behave as today.
acceptanceChecks: With a Plan route the documents, units and error messages are exactly those of the existing tests, and without a route prepareReviewPacket re-reads a stored packet as it does today
An LLD-only, an ISSUE-only and a no-document route each accept exactly their set, and a Plan route whose Story has a DEF requires the story role while a standalone Plan route does not

A set that differs from the route, a document of the wrong workflow, epicHash, issueHash or story, and an ISSUE role supplied alongside an LLD or Plan are each refused with a message naming the roles or the document
